title: Equivariant twisted $R$-algebras via Thom spectra
summary: For a $C_2$-commutative ring spectrum $R$, a twisted $R$-algebra is an $R$-module with a multiplication whose order is switched by the $C_2$-action. In this paper, we construct various quotients of $R$ as twisted $R$-algebras, when $R$ is an even real commutative ring spectrum. These are constructed as Thom spectra of maps out of suitable $C_2$-actions on $S^1$ and $U(n)$. One such example is given by $K\mathbb{R}$ which is endowed with a twisted $K\mathbb{R}$-algebra structure. Other examples include quotients such as $M\mathbb{R}/(2,x_1,\dots, x_{n-1})$ over the real bordism spectrum…
